scenarios.name: Routine patrol
scenarios.description: Single drone flies the full checkpoint circuit and returns to base.

scenarios.name: Single threat alert
scenarios.description: Threat at Z1 (highest score). Dispatch the fastest drone via A*.

scenarios.name: Multiple simultaneous alerts
scenarios.description: All zones demand patrol at once. Max-flow allocates flight-hours; min-cut names the bottleneck.

scenarios.name: Relay tower failure
scenarios.description: Relay R5 fails. Recompute the minimum backbone and report critical links.

scenarios.name: New threat mid-patrol
scenarios.description: New threat at Z8 appears mid-circuit. Compare A* dispatch vs NN reroute cost.

scenarios.name: Full fleet stress test
scenarios.description: Run patrol + allocate + relay + a burst of dispatches end to end.

scenarios.name: Multi-drone fleet routing
scenarios.description: Split the survey across a 3-drone fleet with 60 km range each (OR-Tools VRP); compare total distance to the single-drone exact circuit.
